method: Each row is one recurring shortfall found in the 1,273 verbatim ClusterMAX review sentences (clustermax.ai cloudreview pages, mostly ClusterMAX 2.0 text published 2025-11-06, 28 rows from 2.1 updates dated 2026-04-20). Claims were read one by one and assigned by hand to a shortfall; providers_affected counts distinct review pages (slugs) with at least one assigned sentence. A claim can sit in more than one row. Absence from a row means not reported, not compliant.
caveat: Review text predates ClusterMAX 3.0 and providers may have fixed items (for example cmcr-tensorwave-08 and -10 say the item is now fixed; cmcr-hotaisle-10 is not reproducible against the live site).

rows.shortfall: No active or passive GPU health checks, or checks not wired into the scheduler
rows.what_customer_observes: Nodes with failing GPUs stay in the scheduler; the customer discovers a bad node by losing a job. Some shops have DCGM installed but not plugged into the scheduler.

cost_to_customer.text: Lost job time on the failed node plus restart from checkpoint. SemiAnalysis's TCO model puts goodput loss at 0.02% (gold, inference H200) to 4.98% (silver, pretrain GB300) of GPU spend, an assumption not a measurement.
cost_to_customer.tie_to_estate_measurement: Our three 1-hour Run 3 arms saw 0, 7 and 0 failed of 8,622 requests, so single-seat health-check value is not visible in our data. Multi-node loss: UNKNOWN (no estate measurement).

likely_fix.text: Enable DCGM background health checks (dcgmi health -c), run them as Slurm HealthCheckProgram or NHC, add Node Problem Detector/GPUd with automated cordon and drain (Draino, NVSentinel or equivalent), and run weekly active checks (dcgmi diag -r 3, nvbandwidth, nccl-tests) on idle nodes.

rows.shortfall: No monitoring dashboard, or a dashboard that is broken or missing GPU/job metrics
rows.what_customer_observes: No dashboard, or a Grafana that is non-functional, missing NVLink/tensor-core/job metrics, or showing wrong numbers (for example InfiniBand at 1.14 Tbit/s).

cost_to_customer.text: Customer builds its own DCGM/Grafana or runs blind; link flaps and throttling go unnoticed (cmcr-vultr-13: flaps with no proactive notification).
cost_to_customer.tie_to_estate_measurement: Run 3 used no shop dashboard; the kit captured GPU state itself via the fingerprint probe. Cost of building monitoring: UNKNOWN (no estate measurement).

likely_fix.text: Deploy kube-prometheus-stack plus dcgm-exporter (at or above 4.8.2 per the audit table), Promtail for dmesg, alert routing, and Slurm sacct-based job views.

rows.shortfall: Slurm or Kubernetes delivered but broken, misconfigured, or stuck at first use
rows.what_customer_observes: Slurm or Kubernetes exists but fails first use: clusters stuck provisioning, rollbacks, sinfo/scontrol disabled, no shared home, slurm-bridge unconfigured, engineers on calls to make it work.

cost_to_customer.text: Engineer days before the first job. SemiAnalysis logged 14 straight hours and five AWS engineers for one HyperPod cluster (cmcr-amazonwebservices-14), and 2 hours to a failed K8s cluster at Gcore (cmcr-gcore-12).
cost_to_customer.tie_to_estate_measurement: Our Run 3 kit went from SSH to workload-ready in 144 s on Hot Aisle and 349 s on DigitalOcean with a working Docker image (ledger-times.json); orchestration handover cost: UNKNOWN (no estate measurement).

likely_fix.text: Add an automated handover acceptance test that runs the expectations-page commands (sinfo, srun -N4 hostname, findmnt -T $HOME, kubectl get storageclass, a two-node nccl-test) before delivery, and fix defaults found (shared home, passwordless SSH, Pyxis/Enroot, topology).

kit_steps: counter step 3 (time to SSH) only covers the VM; cluster handover has no kit step yet

rows.shortfall: No usable shared filesystem at delivery (no shared home, RWX class missing, mounts flake, volume not mounted)
rows.what_customer_observes: Home directory is node-local, so data must be copied by hand; RWX StorageClass missing so PVCs cannot deploy; filesystems randomly unmount; a 200 GB disk attached but not mounted.

cost_to_customer.text: Multi-node jobs cannot start or lose data on unmounts; hours of manual setup per user.
cost_to_customer.tie_to_estate_measurement: The Hot Aisle Run 3 arm used a local HF cache (/home/hotaisle/hf-cache, invocation.json); neither Run 3 arm exercised shared storage. Cost: UNKNOWN (no estate measurement).

likely_fix.text: Provision a parallel or NFS shared filesystem mounted at the default home with a stated quota, a default RWX StorageClass, and keep it mounted (health-check mounts).

rows.shortfall: Access blocked or delayed by KYC, account deactivation, invitation-only beta, or waits of weeks to months
rows.what_customer_observes: KYC blocks a first test, accounts are deactivated mid-test, verification calls demand use-case explanations, invitation-only betas, or waits of weeks to months.

cost_to_customer.text: Weeks of calendar time before any GPU-hour; for IBM the account was shut down twice during a simple docker download test (cmcr-ibmcloud-13).
cost_to_customer.tie_to_estate_measurement: Our reference seats took 122 s (Hot Aisle) and 83 s (DigitalOcean) from create to SSH once an account existed; DigitalOcean's zero GPU limit took a support ticket ('under a day', untimed). Signup-to-first-create time: UNKNOWN (both records 'unobserved').

rows.shortfall: Underlying provider undisclosed, or hardware quality a roll of the dice (aggregators)
rows.what_customer_observes: Customer lands on hardware from an unnamed datacenter (Sesterce on Verda's Helsinki hardware, Qubrid on AWS Ashburn), sees PCIe vs SXM chosen by chance, and cannot see who patches or secures it.

cost_to_customer.text: Roll-of-the-dice performance and unclear responsibility; users waste time spinning pods up and down to test quality (cmcr-runpod-16).
cost_to_customer.tie_to_estate_measurement: Between two disclosed providers running the same freeze, Run 3 p99 TTFT differed 3.9x (571 ms vs 2,254 ms) while accepted counts differed 1.3%; whether an undisclosed mix widens that is a hypothesis, not a measurement.

likely_fix.text: Name the underlying operator in the console/docs, expose SXM vs PCIe, and publish region and provider per instance.

kit_steps: desk review + IP/whois lookup on the delivered seat

rows.shortfall: Base image not AI-ready: no GPU driver, Docker or container toolkit, or outdated PyTorch/CUDA
rows.what_customer_observes: Default image has no GPU driver or Docker or container toolkit, an 8 GB root volume too small to install drivers, outdated PyTorch, CUDA 12.4 toolkit on Blackwell, or drivers on one machine but Docker on another.

cost_to_customer.text: Setup hours before the first job; insecure or non-working stack.
cost_to_customer.tie_to_estate_measurement: On images that already had Docker and GPU runtime our kit reached workload-ready in 144 s (Hot Aisle) and 349 s (DigitalOcean); install time on a bare image: UNKNOWN (no estate measurement).

likely_fix.text: Curate one AI-ready image per GPU vendor: driver, Docker with NVIDIA/ROCm runtime, Python with pip/venv, current PyTorch, CUDA at or above the Blackwell minimum.

rows.shortfall: Failed nodes are not drained or replaced automatically; repair is manual or customer-detected
rows.what_customer_observes: An injected PCIe replay error did not drain the node; hardware failure with no alert over 18 hours; a node down two days; customers must notice and report; automated drain 'still on the roadmap'.

cost_to_customer.text: Downtime measured in days; SemiAnalysis credits automated detection-plus-remediation as the differentiator of gold-tier providers.
cost_to_customer.tie_to_estate_measurement: UNKNOWN (no estate measurement). No recovery drill has been run on a real shop (MANUAL preamble).

likely_fix.text: Wire detection to automatic cordon/drain and replace: DCGM health plus NHC HealthCheckProgram in Slurm, Node Problem Detector plus Draino/NVSentinel in Kubernetes.

rows.shortfall: HPC software missing on Slurm nodes: no HPC-X, MPI, NCCL, nvcc or lmod modules

cost_to_customer.text: Each user reinstalls the toolchain; NCCL medium-message performance suffers without HPC-X.
cost_to_customer.tie_to_estate_measurement: UNKNOWN (no estate measurement).

likely_fix.text: Preinstall HPC-X (or equivalent MPI), nvcc, NCCL and Lmod in the base image and on compute nodes.
